title: ConfigLyzer: automated validator for batching/caching recommendations with staged rollback choreography
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Objective: Build ConfigLyzer — a pre-apply validator and staged-rollback orchestration layer for automated batching/caching recommendations. The validator runs a fast, production-representative multi-metric eval and returns a graded verdict (Accept / Accept-with-constraints / Reject). If an apply proceeds, ConfigLyzer runs a progressive deployment choreography with automatic rollback triggers tied to the same eval metrics.

Background: Our cost autotuner produces batching/cache configuration recommendations that reduce unit cost but risk subtle quality regressions (hallucination, truncation, semantic drift). Existing guardrails are anchor-based and golden prompt checks; we need a higher-throughput, reproducible pre-apply validator plus a deterministic staged rollback plan that can operate in hosted, dedicated, and private deployments.

Scope:
- Implement a validator service that ingests a candidate config and workload profile, simulates (shadow) request execution using cached traces, and computes a multi-dimensional regression score.
- Define a standardized verdict schema and remediation suggestions (e.g., reduce microbatch size to X, disable prefix prefetch for model Y).
- Implement canary orchestration that applies recommendations progressively (0% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%) with automatic evaluation gates at each step.
- Integrate golden-prompt suite, stratified production traces, human-audit hooks, and a statistical detection engine for semantic drift.
- Expose console UI metadata and an API for programmatic use by Cost Tuner and Ops.
acceptance_criteria: Validator runs within 90s for typical recommendation payload and returns a verdict with detailed metric deltas.
Multi-metric score includes: token-level latency, rouge-like semantic delta, hallucination proxy score, response length fidelity, and top-k token divergence.
Verdict schema supports Accept, Accept-with-constraints, Reject and contains actionable remediation text.
Canary choreography executes staged traffic shifts and enforces evaluation gates at 5% and 25% with automatic rollback on threshold breaches.
Console surfaces validator results, per-route diffs, and a single-click revert for rolling back to previous config.
Integration tests that replay 10k stratified traces and demonstrate false-positive rate <= 2% on held-out stable configs.
Documentation (PRD + runbook) and one operational runbook drill completed with SRE signoff.

implementation_notes: Validator will reuse persisted trace corpus (persisted-trace-v2) and a lightweight sandbox runtime to run candidate configs without touching production caches.
Semantic-delta measurement uses embedding-based cosine distance between reference outputs and candidate outputs layered with a small classifier trained on historical regressions.
Hallucination proxy uses named-entity overgeneration and token-likelihood-divergence heuristics as an early signal.
Compute budget: aim for a validator cost <= 0.1x of the monthly savings projected by the recommendation (to prevent validator overhead from negating benefit).
Staged apply will leverage existing rollout APIs and add an 'evaluation hook' that calls the validator at each stage; rollback will be atomic per-route and support cross-region barriers.
test_plan: Unit tests for verdict serializer and remediation generator.
Integration test: simulate end-to-end canary with 10k replayed traces and assert gates for semantics and latency.
A/B experiment: compare baseline vs applied config on stratified customer segments for 72h with bootstrap CI on semantic delta.
Human audit: create 200 golden prompts across high-risk routes and verify human reviewer agreement >= 95% on flagged regressions.
Chaos test: induce worker queue latency spikes during canary to verify circuit-breaker triggers rollback.
rollout_plan: Stage 0 (dry-run): Validator runs in pre-apply mode and stores verdicts in console; no apply performed. Target: 1 week.
Stage 1 (shadow apply): Apply happens in shadow for 1% traffic with metric collection only. Duration: 48h.
Stage 2 (small canary): Route 5% traffic to applied config. Evaluate gates after 6h; rollback on breach.
Stage 3 (expanded canary): Route 25% traffic. Run full golden-prompt sweep and human audit if any soft-fail alerts. Duration: 48h.
Stage 4 (full rollout): 100% traffic. Monitor 72h with elevated alerting; automatic rollback window 72h.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Validator false negatives let regressions through. Mitigation: conservative thresholds for first 3 months and mandatory human audit for medium/high-risk routes.

Risk: Validator costs exceed savings for small-customer recommendations. Mitigation: cost-based gating — only run validator for recommendations with > $X monthly savings or when applied automatically across > N routes.
Risk: Canary-induced instability in Dedicated clusters. Mitigation: Dedicated customers get opt-in; provide simulated pre-apply only for opt-out customers.
Risk: Overfitting to golden prompts. Mitigation: maintain diverse trace corpus and rotate golden prompts monthly; include synthetic adversarial prompts.
operational_playbook: On failure at any canary gate: Immediately pause rollout, call on-call SRE, create incident with 'configlyzer-canary-breach' tag, and trigger automatic rollback.
Human review flow: assign reviewer via console UI; reviewer must mark 'approve' or provide remediation within 24h for staged canaries.
Post-rollback: auto-generate a regression report summarizing metric deltas and attach to the recommendation object for Cost Tuner review.
notes: This ticket intentionally separates pre-apply semantic validation from the cost-tuner recommendation engine to keep concerns modular.
